package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// ComposeConfigTechRepoPG implements ComposeConfigTechRepository.
type ComposeConfigTechRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// Add links compose config to tech.
func (r ComposeConfigTechRepoPG) Add(ctx context.Context, composeConfigID string, techID int) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO compose_config_tech (compose_config_id, tech_id) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`,
		composeConfigID, techID)
	return err
}

// Replace updates compose config tech links to exact set.
func (r ComposeConfigTechRepoPG) Replace(ctx context.Context, composeConfigID string, techIDs []int) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM compose_config_tech WHERE compose_config_id=$1`, composeConfigID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, techID := range techIDs {
		if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO compose_config_tech (compose_config_id, tech_id) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`, composeConfigID, techID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// ListTechIDs lists tech ids for compose config.
func (r ComposeConfigTechRepoPG) ListTechIDs(ctx context.Context, composeConfigID string) ([]int, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `SELECT tech_id FROM compose_config_tech WHERE compose_config_id=$1 ORDER BY tech_id`, composeConfigID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var ids []int
	for rows.Next() {
		var id int
		if err := rows.Scan(&id); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		ids = append(ids, id)
	}
	return ids, nil
}

var _ repository.ComposeConfigTechRepository = (*ComposeConfigTechRepoPG)(nil)
